fact: L'Union reports a Libreville workshop opened 8 July 2024 to evaluate the plan of an education statistical yearbook, following a school data collection involving several administrations including the Direction generale de la Statistique.

Open Data Watch's ODIN (2024 round) lists the statistics office's health, education and human development publication as giving numbers of public schools, technical schools, institutions and teachers, latest data year 2021.
Open Data Watch's ODIN (2024 round) lists a statistics office publication as giving detainees by type of infraction and prisoners by sex, latest data year 2017.
